newsitem.title: USA: Howard Gary & Co to co-manage Dade Cty, Fla., deal.
newsitem.headline: Howard Gary & Co to co-manage Dade Cty, Fla., deal.

text.p: Dade County manager's finance committee affirmed Howard Gary & Co's participation as co-manager for a $120 million solid waste refunding issue, the firm's first deal for the county since its president was linked to a corruption probe, officials involved in the deal said.
A.G. Edwards & Son Inc is senior manager for the issue, scheduled to price Dec 10.
The manager's finance commitee approved the selection on Nov 13, and it was scheduled to go before the county commission for final approval Tuesday.
Financial advisers on the deal said they did not believe the firm's participation would hurt pricing.

Howard Gary & Co is a member of the county's standing pool of bond underwriters. But the firm had been dismissed from other Dade bond issues since it was disclosed that company president Howard Gary had worn a hidden wire and was cooperating with federal investigators in their "Operation Greenpalm" probe of public finance corruption in Dade County and the City of Miami.

Three weeks ago, Gary's lawyer, Peter Raben, gave the county a copy of an Oct 30 letter from Assistant U.S. Attorney Mary Butler, stating that the firm is not a subject or target of the investigation.
